title: The MiddleTones return to Middleton Arena after last year's sold-out show
excerpt: Middleton's Big Night returns to Middleton Arena on Saturday 15 August, with The MiddleTones, Stone Roses guitarist Aziz Ibrahim, DJ Clint Boon and Louis Collier on the bill.
body:
The MiddleTones are returning to Middleton Arena this Saturday after last year's event sold out and drew strong feedback from those who attended.

Middleton's Big Night will take place on Saturday 15 August, promising an evening built around live music, local talent and the sounds of Manchester's celebrated indie scene.

Organisers say the event is designed as a chance for people to reconnect with old friends, discover local performers, enjoy a drink and take part in one of the biggest nights on Middleton's social calendar.

The music will lean heavily into the era of Manchester clubs such as 5th Ave, 42nd Street and The Venue, with a set expected to feature singalong anthems, familiar indie classics and plenty of nostalgia.

Live support is set to include Stone Roses guitarist Aziz Ibrahim, DJ Clint Boon and Louis Collier, adding some major Manchester music names to the night.

The return follows what organisers describe as a sold-out show last year, with demand expected to be high again for this year's event.

Middleton's Big Night takes place at Middleton Arena on Saturday 15 August. Anyone planning to attend is advised to check ticket availability in advance, particularly given last year's sell-out.

Event details and line-up information may be subject to change.
legal_disclaimer: Event details and line-up information are based on organiser information and may be subject to change.
